header.tagline: Public map of communities and digital presence

footer.tagline: Digital presence, public map and community in a single ecosystem.
footer.description: Discover communities, showcase your space on the map and connect people to the app and the admin panel.
footer.copyright: © 2026 EclessGO. Public platform for discovery and digital presence of communities.

page.title: Put your community on the EclessGO map
page.intro: This flow is meant to be direct: fewer steps, clear data and no detour to the panel before the initial registration. Once done, the responsible person can move on to the community's operation.

requirements.responsible: Responsible person with name, email and password for initial access.
requirements.identity: Community name and tradition, line or denomination for the public page and the app.
requirements.address: Readable address with street, city and state.
requirements.coordinates: Valid latitude and longitude to enter the map.

mapCoherent.title: Coherent map
mapCoherent.description: The site only shows communities with valid latitude and longitude, avoiding invented markers and reinforcing trust in the product.

panelEntry.title: Entry into the panel
panelEntry.description: After registration, the community enters the panel's operational flow for adjustments, schedule and management.

moreChannels.title: Same data, more channels
moreChannels.description: The same registration feeds the community's public page, the web directory and the app.

intro.title: Register your community
intro.description: Community name, readable address and latitude/longitude are required for your space to appear correctly on the map.

footer.note: After registration, your community enters the panel flow and can appear on the public map and the app.

media.label: Media

media.description: Add the images that help visitors recognize the community in public cards.

contact.label: Contact
contact.title: Public contact
contact.description: Provide the channels visitors can use to reach the community directly.

media.logoDescription: Ideal for avatar, cards and quick visual identification.
media.coverDescription: Horizontal image for the top of the public profile.

registerSuccess.description: The person linked to <email></email> can now move to the panel and complete the community's operation. If the coordinates are correct, the community can also appear on the public map and the app.
registerSuccess.panelStepDesc: Review description, contacts, schedule and other administrative information.
registerSuccess.mapStepDesc: Confirming latitude and longitude keeps the public presence coherent and searchable.

consent.title: Do you accept measurement cookies?
consent.description: We use anonymous signals (no personal identification) to understand how communities are found and to improve the product. You can change your mind later in the <link>privacy settings</link>.

hero.badge: Local communities made easier to find
hero.title: Digital presence for communities that want to be found.
hero.description: EclessGO turns registration, location and public information into a simple journey: the community organizes its presence, and people understand where to go, when to visit and how to get in touch.

visible.label: Visible communities
visible.description: Published spaces with enough information to be discovered.

live.label: Live now
live.description: Communities with highlighted activity for people looking for something happening now.

ecosystem.label: Ecosystem
ecosystem.description: One base for registration, panel, public discovery and mobile experience.

mapPreview.description: Nearby communities, published and ready to welcome people
mapPreview.apiError: The EclessGO public API is not responding right now. The map preview will load again as soon as the backend is active.
mapPreview.empty: No community with valid coordinates was found for the preview. The site remains functional and public registration is ready to feed the map.

findable.title: Findable communities
findable.description: Help people find real spaces near home, with a clear address and a trustworthy public page.

operation.title: Operations in one place
operation.description: Update public data, schedule, members and digital presence without spreading information across several tools.

mobile.title: Continuity on mobile
mobile.description: The same registration prepares the community to be discovered on the site, map and app.

howItWorks.title: From registration to visit, without losing community context.
howItWorks.description: The platform organizes what is usually scattered: address, schedule, contacts, public page and internal operation. That way, the community is presentable to first-time visitors and manageable for the people who care for it every day.

steps.first: Register the community with name, identity, address, contacts and public location.
steps.second: Complete the essential information in the panel to make the page ready for visitors.
steps.third: Nearby people discover the community, understand when to visit and know how to get in touch.

forCommunities.title: What your community needs to show up well on the map
forCommunities.description: EclessGO can support churches, temples, centers and other meeting spaces. For the product to work reliably, registration needs to start clear and complete.

address.title: Readable address
address.description: Street, city and state need to exist for the public page to make sense.

coordinates.title: Latitude and longitude
coordinates.description: Without valid coordinates, the community does not enter the web map or public listing.

identity.title: Space identity
identity.description: Name, tradition, category or short description help visitor conversion.

contact.title: Public contact
contact.description: Phone and email are not mandatory, but they make the page much more useful.

forPeople.title: Public discovery today, complete journey in the app.
forPeople.description: The site is the showcase. The app is continuity. People find the community on the map, open the public page and move to the mobile experience when they want to go deeper.

map.title: Lightweight web map for discovery
map.description: People find nearby communities, compare essential information and move to the public page without friction.

publicPage.title: Public page per community
publicPage.description: Each space gets its own route designed for sharing and SEO.

appCta.title: Direct CTA to the app
appCta.description: When people want to go beyond the site, the transition to the app is already planned.

finalCta.title: Public site, panel and mobile speaking the same language.
finalCta.description: The platform starts with a coherent base: public community registration, real listing, public slug route and discovery based only on spaces published in EclessGO.
